High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Platform API.

Provides platform conditional macros and display constants.

Imports

../ffi

Consts

ActionBarWidth = 30
Width of the action bar in pixels. 
PBLDisplayHeight = 168
Display height in pixels. 168 for Aplite/Basalt/Diorite/Flint, 180 for Chalk (round), 228 for Emery. 
PBLDisplayWidth = 144
Display width in pixels. 144 for Aplite/Basalt/Diorite/Flint, 180 for Chalk (round), 200 for Emery. 
StatusBarLayerHeight = 16
Height of the status bar layer in pixels.

Templates

template colorFallback(color, fallback: GColor): GColor
Returns color on color platforms, fallback on black and white. Equivalent to C macro pattern for platform-aware color selection. 
template pblIfBwElse[T](bwExpr, colorExpr: T): T
Platform conditional: returns bwExpr on black and white watches, colorExpr on color watches. Equivalent to C macro PBL_IF_BW_ELSE(bw_expr, color_expr). 
template pblIfColorElse[T](colorExpr, bwExpr: T): T
Platform conditional: returns colorExpr on color watches, bwExpr on black and white watches. Equivalent to C macro PBL_IF_COLOR_ELSE(color_expr, bw_expr). 
template pblIfRectElse[T](rectExpr, roundExpr: T): T
Platform conditional: returns rectExpr on rectangular watches, roundExpr on round watches. Equivalent to C macro PBL_IF_RECT_ELSE(rect_expr, round_expr). 
template pblIfRoundElse[T](roundExpr, rectExpr: T): T
Platform conditional: returns roundExpr on round watches, rectExpr on rectangular watches. Equivalent to C macro PBL_IF_ROUND_ELSE(round_expr, rect_expr).
